collections-original-backend.command: node scripts/run-backend-acceptance.cjs (original all profile; only these archived results reviewed now)
limitations: Two original test files in one historical backend execution; separate disposable databases
No new execution, no App/Vue coverage inferred
Normal fixtures synthesized; three history time fields adjusted solely for retention boundary

equals.name: default settings require explicit opt-in and advertise original limits
201 independently approved notices create at most 200 actual history rows
30-day recorded time and explicit expiry both physically purge; day29 survives
replaying old visits or queued writes cannot resurrect trimmed or cleared rows
default collection retention: 201 real visits, 200 retained, 30-day physical purge and stale replay
history is off by default; reads are personal and reject acting identities
same favourite is unique, own-account only, and old replay cannot undo removal
explicit opt in, replayable visits and no automatic browsing from GET
single delete and clear invalidate queued visits and cannot resurrect deleted data
bounded recent history, signed pagination and clear protect cursor scope
disabling clears history; stale opt-in or visits cannot silently restore it
expiry removes stored rows, private content is not copied into collection/command tables
concurrent saves deduplicate and concurrent preference changes honor version
withdrawn or blocked sources remain removable without old titles or private fields
retention job checks its lease, physically purges inactive users and reschedules
personal collections, privacy preferences and retention through actual HTTP
stock favorites reuse actual publication and rights checks
